bagPolicy.summary: The Walmart AMP has specific guidelines regarding the types and sizes of bags allowed into the venue. Guests are encouraged to review these policies before attending an event.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: Reserved-parking upgrades guarantee a space in one of three selected lots near the venue. Buy the upgrade with your ticket or separately, subject to availability.

rideshare.note: Use the Embassy Suites parking lot for rideshare. Drivers enter through the north entrance at Rogers Convention Center. Drop-off is in the southeast corner of the lot. Pickup is in the south corner.

concessions.note: Food and beverage concessions operate for most concerts, with event-specific selection and hours. Review the current Walmart AMP venue policy before bringing outside items.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Walmart AMP, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Walmart AMP's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: The walk-up box office opens at 1 p.m. on concert days. Call 479-443-5600 for ticket help.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Walmart AMP. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
